g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_front: Keys: 1000 x 600 x 800 mm envelope - the node size_mm (the study registry box; the seed 800 x 800 x 800 "loop vessel beside GHEX" figure predates it - the node governs, hold W12)

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Closed source-loop distribution skid per the node design block: the loop between the GHEX bore field and the heat-pump evaporators (GEO_HP) - DN32 HDPE supply/return header runs, the loop buffer manifold vessel (OD 220 x 300, study, W12), the circulator envelope (125.7 W, node)

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Loop: 25 % propylene glycol (freeze protection to -10 C, node material), design case 3 kW th at 0.2564 kg/s, dT 3 K, head 25 m (node design); the S43 class edge runs at 0 kW idle standby
Graph revision AD - ga_front: Route hold carried by name: the node class is blank - no section 4 class (AFTERBURNER_FLUE/REE_RECOVER precedent)
